retired.go-container: Container element types are one source of receiver information. The stored receiver-type reason includes them and other receiver forms.
retired.go-external-fields: The graph groups these with other unproved library members and unknown receiver types. The source review distinguishes field and embedding examples.
retired.go-external-import: Shipped for proved package bindings. Remaining module-choice and unknown-receiver cases have their own rows.
retired.go-external-targets: Shipped. The fresh graph stores library symbol targets directly.
retired.go-file-broken-fixture: File diagnostics are tracked separately. Source files that emit no links contribute no stored misses.
retired.go-file-go-grammar: File diagnostics are tracked separately. Source files that emit no links contribute no stored misses.
retired.go-factory: Return-value and field propagation share the stored receiver-type and library-member reasons with other calls.
retired.go-fields: The graph groups these with other unknown receiver and declaration lookups. It has no stored reason specific to local fields.
retired.go-generated: The graph records uncertain module choice and potentially unseen declarations. It has no stored reason specific to generated Go.
retired.go-local-method: The receiver-type and potentially unseen declaration reasons cover the remaining local cases along with other receivers.
retired.go-pointer-conversion: Shipped. The resolver links checked-in pointer conversions to their type declarations.
retired.go-type-parameter: The old sample grouped these by source syntax. The graph reports their remaining lookups under the stored receiver, declaration or unexplained groups.
retired.go-typed-reference: The fresh groups distinguish unclear package destinations, unseen declarations and missing receiver types.
retired.rust-chain: A chain can fail at a receiver, callee or later method lookup step. The current inventory groups by the actual stored blocker.
retired.rust-external-targets: Shipped. The fresh graph stores library symbol targets directly.
retired.rust-file-rust-parameter-attribute: Shipped. The grammar reads parameter attributes in the affected pins.
retired.rust-file-rust-snapshot-macro: Shipped. The grammar reads the nested token trees in the affected snapshot fixtures.
retired.rust-file-template: File diagnostics are tracked separately. Unrendered source can emit no links.
retired.rust-glob: No below-Level-2 link in the fresh finished Rust graphs has this as its first stored reason. The archive retains secondary reasons.
retired.rust-imported-function: The graph groups these with other namespace and import lookups. It does not distinguish imported functions by reason.
retired.rust-let: The receiver-type group includes both local binding inference and other sources of receiver types.
retired.rust-parameter: The graph has no stored reason specific to generic parameters. The current groups use each parameter lookup's stored reason.
retired.rust-self-trait: The current reasons distinguish associated owners, applicable implementations and trait dispatch.
retired.rust-std-path: The graph distinguishes unresolved path types from prelude and other namespace questions. Standard-library targets appear in several groups.
retired.rust-std-receiver: The stored receiver and method lookup reasons cover both local and external owners. The sample distinguishes what needs library source.
retired.rust-taint: Mislabelled. The old aggregate assigned unrelated misses to failed files. The narrower reason covers only lookups that can reach a failed file.
retired.rust-typed-receiver: The graph groups explicit and inferred receiver types together when it cannot complete the lookup.
retired.rust-value: Local values and patterns appear in the unexplained and namespace groups. The old source-review label was broader than a stored reason.
retired.ts-bundle: Compiled bundles can miss a local anchor for the same reason as other files. The local declaration item covers these links.
retired.ts-bundle-flow: The graph groups bundle flow alongside other receiver and object producer lookups.
retired.ts-config-preset: Combined under incomplete configuration, which covers missing presets and other incomplete settings.
retired.ts-external-targets: Shipped. The fresh graph stores library symbol targets directly.
retired.ts-inline: The graph has no reason specific to immediately invoked functions. Remaining calls use the local declaration or other stored reasons.
retired.ts-local-chain: The fresh reasons distinguish object producers from any and unknown receivers.
retired.ts-nested-function: The graph groups nested declarations lacking an anchor with other local declarations.
retired.ts-object-member: Member lookups can fail at the producer, receiver type or declaration anchor. The new rows follow those stored reasons.
retired.ts-script-tag: The graph does not label links by the presence of a browser script tag. Relevant missing targets use the stored runtime, global or receiver reasons.
retired.ts-type-parameters: Shipped. The generic parameter anchors settled the 23 previously tracked reference sites.
retired.typescript-file-broken-fixture: File diagnostics are tracked separately. Source files that emit no links contribute no stored misses.
retired.typescript-file-manifest-bom: File diagnostics are tracked separately. A manifest is context for linking and does not emit links of its own.
retired.typescript-file-template: File diagnostics are tracked separately. Unrendered source can emit no links.
retired.typescript-file-tsconfig: File diagnostics are tracked separately. Configuration blockers on emitted links have their own row.
